segments: Dig snowy dig sites in the spawn / starting trenches.
Dig snowy dig sites around the middle / Excavation area.
Dig snowy dig sites around the Church area.
Check the three spawn points inside the Tank Station by Generator 2.
Take the blue record and Gramophone to the Ice Tunnel by Generator 6, enter the Crazy Place, and collect the blue crystal.
Use the blue pedestal beneath the Excavation Site.
Return through the Ice Tunnel and enter the Crazy Place with the Ice Staff.
Use the code chart to match the blue-dot pillar symbol to the correct ceiling stone.
Shoot each matching ceiling stone with the Ice Staff until the puzzle completes.
Find all three gravestones on the main map, freeze each one with the Ice Staff, then shoot the frozen stone with a normal bullet weapon to break it.
At the Excavation Site, use the four levers to align every ring to BLUE.
Go below the rings and shoot the blue orb with the Ice Staff.
Return to the Crazy Place and place the Ice Staff on the blue pedestal.
Kill zombies around the pedestal until the staff is fully charged, then pick it up.
